name: PuntoWoo Loyalty & Digital Wallet for WooCommerce
author: NovekDev

sections.description:
PuntoWoo Loyalty & Digital Wallet for WooCommerce is a powerful, self-contained loyalty and gift card management platform. It gives your customers a seamless digital membership experience, allowing them to earn points on purchases, redeem points for store credit, and pay using gift cards both online and in-store.

Key Features

  • Digital Customer Wallet & Pass: Beautiful virtual member pass in WooCommerce My Account with 10-digit card number and live balance counters.
  • In-Store Barcode Scanner: Scannable Code 128 SVG barcode on the customer wallet page for instant POS terminal integration.
  • Personal Transaction History: Full audit trail in the customer account with 10-per-page pagination and activity filters.
  • Points & Rewards Engine: Automatically awards points for completed orders and allows flexible conversion to wallet balance.
  • Checkout Integration: Frictionless gift card discount redemption directly on the WooCommerce checkout page.
  • HPOS & WooCommerce Blocks Compatible: Fully declared and tested with High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables) and Block Cart/Checkout.
  • Admin CRM & CSV Importer: Manage member profiles, adjust balances, and batch import customer cards via AJAX.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the loyalty folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP directly via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your points conversion rates and store settings under Loyalty Program > Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this support High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, HPOS compatibility is fully declared and supported.

Can customers use their card in physical retail stores?

Yes, customers can open My Account > Loyalty & Gift Card on their smartphone to show their scannable SVG barcode to the cashier.
